method: Records sorted by luokka (rule class) and tyyppi (use). No-parking, bicycle, e-scooter and parklet records left out. Estimated spaces = sum of positive paikat_ala of general car parking records whose bounding-box centre is within 200 m (straight line) of the building centre. Records with missing, zero or invalid paikat_ala are counted as having no estimate. Zones by point in polygon at the building centre. Not live free spaces, not private parking.
